sources.title: GitHub - hydrocam/water-segmentation
sources.snippet: Water Segmentation This repository provides a complete pipeline for training, evaluating, and testing SAM-based (Segment Anything Model and MobileSAM) and Segformer models for river water segmentation using RGB imagery. It includes code for model fine-tuning, inference, accuracy evaluation, and edge deployment tests.

sources.title: Evaluating Different Deep Learning Models for Automatic Water ...
sources.snippet: Evaluating Different Deep Learning Models for Automatic Water Segmentation Abstract: Deep learning (DL) methods, integrated with imagery obtained by remote sensors, are considered a novel source of information in the field of hydrometry. Their results can be a support for standard gauging systems.

sources.title: water module - GeoAI
sources.snippet: water module Provides water body segmentation from satellite and aerial imagery using deep learning models. This module detects and delineates water features such as rivers, lakes, ponds, and coastal areas, producing binary masks and vector polygons suitable for hydrological analysis and flood mapping.
